listings.name: Lone Mountain Wagyu
listings.description: Full-blood wagyu beef raised at our New Mexico cattle ranch. Hormone and antibiotic-free, with exceptional marbling and flavor.

listings.name: HeartBrand Beef
listings.genetics: Certified Akaushi Beef® - only company with this certification
listings.description: Fifth generation ranch with the largest herd of Akaushi cattle in the country. All HeartBrand Certified Akaushi Beef is USDA Prime quality grade.

listings.name: Long Hill Wagyu
listings.description: Hand-picked herd of 100% Wagyu cattle, blending slow natural approach with modern nutritional science.

listings.name: Circle H Ranch
listings.description: Grass-finished, no antibiotics, no hormones, no grains. Raised on two ranches between Wyoming and Idaho.

listings.name: Hawks Hill Ranch
listings.description: Raised in the Greater Yellowstone Ecosystem since 2015. Dry-aged 14-18 days, USDA graded and certified.

listings.name: Slickhorn Ranch
listings.description: Raised on 600,000+ acres of Northern Rockies rangeland. Diamond grading system for marbling levels.

listings.name: Pasture Prime Wagyu
listings.shipping: Ships throughout US; Saturday farm pickup 9-11am
listings.note: Family farm since 1976, also offers Berkshire pork and pastured poultry
listings.description: Among a handful of farms producing 100% grass-fed & finished Wagyu. Saturday pickups available at the farm.

listings.name: Rutledge Ryan Ranch
listings.genetics: 100% Fullblood Wagyu; tracked genetic lineages from Japan
listings.description: Dry-aged for peak flavor. No steroids, growth hormones, or unnecessary antibiotics.

listings.name: Mahan Wagyu (Ranch & Trail)
listings.genetics: 100% Fullblood Japanese Wagyu; registered with American Wagyu Association
listings.description: 2,500-acre ranch at the edge of Palo Duro Canyon. Grass-fed, grain-finished, dry-aged 14-21 days.

listings.name: Mossyrock Wagyu
listings.description: Raised in the Klickitat Valley between Mt. Rainier and Mt. St. Helens. Never use hormones or antibiotics.

listings.name: Grant Cattle Company
listings.note: Veteran-owned ranch; cattle raised and finished on-site, never sent to feedlot
listings.description: Family-run, veteran-owned ranch raising Fullblood and American Wagyu. Raised and finished right on our ranch.

listings.name: Black Wagyu Beef Co.
listings.genetics: American Wagyu (minimum 83% Wagyu) and Fullblood Japanese Wagyu; DNA-tested
listings.shipping: Florida only (free delivery within 100 miles of ranch; free pickup at ranch)
listings.note: Florida-only shipping at this time (beta testing)
listings.description: Multi-family operation on 130 acres in horse country between Ocala and Gainesville. Cattle live entire lives on pasture.

listings.name: Quinn Beef
listings.description: Family operation raising DNA-verified Akaushi cattle on all-natural ration formulated specifically for the breed.

listings.name: Tribe Ranch
listings.shipping: 48 contiguous states (free shipping on orders $300+); local delivery within 100 miles
listings.description: Grass-fed, grain-finished. All-natural with no hormones. Registered with American Akaushi Association.

listings.name: Hook & Cleaver Ranch
listings.city: Temecula & Murrieta, CA; Lake Havasu City, AZ
listings.genetics: American Akaushi Wagyu; DNA-tested and registered
listings.shipping: Walk-in retail shops (Temecula, Murrieta, Lake Havasu); also ships nationwide
listings.description: Free-range on 250,000 acres of Idaho pasture. Three retail butcher shop locations, Mon-Fri 10am-5pm.

listings.name: Chapel Hill Farm
listings.genetics: Critically endangered Randall Lineback heritage breed (genetics date to 1600s)
listings.shipping: Ships nationwide; local pickup in DC/MD/VA
listings.description: 100% pasture-based. Deep, rich flavor without heavy intramuscular fat. Mission to save critically endangered Randall Lineback breed.

listings.name: Certified Piedmontese
listings.genetics: Piedmontese cattle (unique myostatin gene for lean, tender beef)
listings.description: Grass-finished, Non-GMO verified. Lean and tender without relying on fatty marbling. Raised on family ranches across the Midwest.

listings.name: Mahanaim Farms
listings.shipping: Pickup only in Salt Lake City (no shipping currently)
listings.description: 100% grass-fed and grass-finished. Regenerative family farm. Dexter cattle known for exceptional marbling and rich flavor.
